recentItems.title: Crew Girl Cast Reveals Grueling Training Process for Netflix Show | E! News
recentItems.description:
‘Crew Girl’ stars Miku Martineau, Sam Braun and Kyle Clark exclusively told E! News just what they had they went through to portray skilled rowers on the Netflix series, premiering Sept. 10. “I was doing night shoots all week, but then on the weekend it was my only free time, so I would have to get up to do rowing training on a lake,” the 21-year-old exclusively shared with E! News during a joint interview with her costars. “But I had such a blast.” In fact, despite the intense training, Martineau “had no complaints,” as the workouts meant she got to learn a new sport and spend time on the water.  Still, it wasn’t all fun and oars, as the cast was filming in British Columbia during the fall months. “There was one day that we did in October,” Braun recalled. “I remember it was really foggy and it was cold ‘cause you're in your leotards and you're waiting for the drone to get set."

recentItems.title: ABC Denies Jimmy Kimmel’s Late Night Show Is Ending After 24 Years | E! News
recentItems.description:
Jimmy Kimmel is not done laughing yet. Following reports that the comedian's late night show 'Jimmy Kimmel Live!' will end after this season after 24 years on the air, ABC set the record straight, denying that the show has been canceled.  "This information is inaccurate," an ABC Entertainment spokesperson told E! News Sept. 8. "Any reports about the future of the show at this point are purely speculative.” E! News reached out to Kimmel's rep but has yet to hear back. Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1435863/is-jimmy-kimmels-show-ending-abc-responds-to-cancellation-rumor

recentItems.title: Lindsay Clancy Jurors Break Silence on Mistrial in Murder Case | E! News
recentItems.description:
Three jurors in Lindsay Clancy's murder trial are sharing what really happened during deliberations. The jurors—identified as Roni Carlson, a fifth grade special needs teacher; Kellie Farina, a chef; and Paula Devlin, who worked for government contractors—spoke out for the first time since a judge declared a mistrial on Sept. 4, slamming one unnamed male juror who held out on an otherwise unanimous verdict of not guilty by reason of insanity. “He was very arrogant… He really did not take anything that anybody said,” Devlin told NBC10 Boston in an interview published Sept. 8. Carlson also alleged that the male juror in question admitted that he had reasonable doubt regarding Clancy’s culpability, but that he still refused to vote to acquit. recentItems.title: Singer Ray LaMontagne Collapses Onstage During Nashville Concert | E! News
recentItems.description:
Folk singer Ray LaMontagne collapsed onstage while performing at Ryman Auditorium in Nashville Sept. 5, with his team later sharing that he was treated for "heat related dehydration." Fan footage showed the 53-year-old, who was performing his 2004 song “Jolene,” falling to the stage as bandmates rushed to help, while his team assured fans that he was doing well. LaMontagne was on his Trouble 20th Anniversary Tour with the Weather Station, which is scheduled to wrap Oct. 3 in New York City.
